title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: The briefing agrees with the roadmap and Microsoft's notice on rollout, prerequisites and administrator-driven operation. Its licensing, Azure storage costs and role-assignment controls are supported. Clarify that the existing PSTImport parameter is documented for on-premises Exchange and internal Microsoft use, not as an Exchange Online import command.

claims.claim: Azure PST Import is a Microsoft Purview change.
claims.quote: "title": "Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import"

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.
claims.quote: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.

claims.claim: The planned method follows a two-step Exchange Migration Service analysis-and-migration pattern.
claims.quote: It follows the standard two-step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration.

claims.claim: The process includes creating a migration endpoint.
claims.quote: The process also involves creating a migration endpoint

claims.claim: The Exchange PowerShell reference lists a PSTImport parameter set on New-MigrationEndpoint, described by the briefing as the Exchange Online PowerShell reference.
claims.quote: ### PSTImport ... [-PSTImport] ... This parameter is available only in on-premises Exchange. This parameter is reserved for internal Microsoft use.
claims.fix: Replace the final sentence of that paragraph with: "The Exchange PowerShell reference lists a `PSTImport` parameter set on New-MigrationEndpoint, but marks `-PSTImport` as available only in on-premises Exchange and reserved for internal Microsoft use; it does not document the Azure PST Import endpoint cmdlet."

claims.claim: The New-MigrationEndpoint reference does not connect its PSTImport parameter set to Azure Blob Storage.
claims.quote: Searched: PSTImport, Azure, Blob and Storage throughout the fetched New-MigrationEndpoint reference; "Azure PST" "MigrationEndpoint" "MigrationBatch" in Learn. No passage ties that parameter set to Azure Blob Storage.

claims.claim: Storage-account role assignment changes can take up to 10 minutes to take effect.
claims.quote: When you assign roles or remove role assignments, it can take up to 10 minutes for changes to take effect.

claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import turns on retention hold for imported mailboxes.
claims.quote: After you import PST files to a Microsoft 365 mailbox, the retention hold setting for the mailbox is turned on indefinitely.

claims.claim: Mailbox retention settings could delete old imported items without retention hold.
claims.quote: If messages you import to a mailbox are old, the retention settings configured for the mailbox might cause those messages to be permanently deleted (purged).

claims.where: Open questions: existing size guidance and limits
claims.claim: Existing Purview PST import guidance says to use PST files no larger than 20 GB.
claims.quote: Upload or copy PST files that are no larger than 20 GB. Large PST files can affect the performance of the import process.

claims.where: Open questions: existing size guidance and limits
claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import has a 150 MB item limit.
claims.quote: If a PST file contains a mailbox item that's larger than 150 MB, the import process skips the item and doesn't import it.

claims.where: Open questions: existing size guidance and limits
claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import cannot import more than 100 GB into a user's archive in a single import.
claims.quote: As a result, you can't import more than 100 GB of data into a user's archive in a single import.

claims.claim: The notice refers to existing Exchange Online and Microsoft Purview audit logging for PST import administrative actions and resulting mailbox changes.
claims.quote: Administrative actions related to PST import and the resulting mailbox changes are logged using existing Exchange Online and Microsoft Purview audit logging mechanisms.
